description: This file defines the CommandEntity class, which maps to the 'm_command' table in the database, representing command data with fields like commandId, createdAt, tenantId, username, and payload. It includes JPA annotations for ORM mapping, Lombok annotations for boilerplate code reduction, and converter integration for JSON handling.

classes.name: CommandEntity
classes.description: Entity class representing a command with persistence annotations and serialization support.

methods.name: markNotNew
methods.description: Sets the 'isNew' flag to false after loading or persisting the entity, indicating it is no longer a new entity.
